name: SQS '*' receive is anonymous public and MUST stay critical (dispatch-bleed near-miss)
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 122. AWS SQS docs label a Principal '*' grant 'all users (anonymous users)', so sqs:ReceiveMessage to '*' is genuinely anonymous public: the generic PUBLIC-ACCESS is critical and resource.anonymous is TRUE. The messaging rule ADDS MESSAGING-PUBLIC-EXPOSURE (high) naming the DRAIN vector. The KMS not-anonymous carve-out (test 109) MUST NOT leak here - the SQS grant keeps its anonymous framing.

MESSAGING-PUBLIC-EXPOSURE: all AWS identities in all accounts
PUBLIC-ACCESS: all AWS identities in all accounts
